families.title: Unconditional long gap+RVOL continuation (Experiment #1)
families.idea_only_reason: Frozen completed experiment; do not rerun as discovery.
families.mechanism: Chasing ≥15% RTH open gap with extreme early RVOL as continuation.

families.title: Extreme gap fade
families.mechanism: Large gap-up + abnormal early volume mean-reverts; first event per ticker-day only.
families.rationale: Experiment #1 long continuation failed monotonically through 60m.
limitations: does not search when reversal starts; window is still 09:35-10:30

families.title: Gap hold-near-high then continuation
families.mechanism: Gap-up that retains the first-15m high then breaks that high continues (long).
families.rationale: Opening-strength retention, not merely staying above the 09:30 open.
limitations: near-high is 0.3% of window high; not VWAP

families.title: Parabolic intraday exhaustion
families.mechanism: Front-loaded 15m advance with expanding volume fades (short).

families.title: Volume shock before price shock
families.mechanism: Abnormal 5m volume while price is still quiet precedes a large unsigned move.
families.rationale: Primary S1 metric is mean |15m|, not a chosen side.
limitations: unsigned metric is not a tradable side

families.title: Price shock without confirming volume
families.idea_only_reason: Needs volume-relative-to-typical threshold pair.
families.mechanism: Large move on weak volume mean-reverts.

families.title: Opening-range breakout
families.idea_only_reason: Range length and volume-expansion rule unspecified.
families.mechanism: Break of first 5/15/30m range with volume expansion continues.

families.title: Failed breakout / trap
families.mechanism: Break of yesterday RTH high reversed within 15m is a trap (short).

families.title: VWAP displacement / reversion
families.idea_only_reason: Bar-VWAP proxy and displacement units unspecified.
families.mechanism: Distance from intraday volume-weighted reference reverts.
limitations: bar VWAP is not exchange trade VWAP

families.title: VWAP reclaim / rejection
families.idea_only_reason: Time-below and reclaim volume rules unspecified.
families.mechanism: Cross of VWAP with abnormal volume continues.

families.title: Premarket move → RTH behavior
families.idea_only_reason: Must separate PM return, gap, and RTH response with explicit clocks.
families.mechanism: Large premarket winner/loser has systematic RTH response.

families.title: Premarket high/low break
families.idea_only_reason: Failed-attempt vs first-clean-break counting rule unspecified.
families.mechanism: RTH cross of premarket high/low is informative.

families.title: Opening reversal
families.idea_only_reason: Giveback fraction and window unspecified.
families.mechanism: Strong first 5–15m then giveback continues to reverse.

families.title: Intraday momentum after consolidation
families.idea_only_reason: Consolidation range/volume and breakout clock unspecified.
families.mechanism: Impulse → tight pause → breakout continues.

families.title: Volatility compression then expansion
families.mechanism: Compression vs own 20d daily range then expansion-bar direction persists.

families.title: Volatility explosion → reversion
families.idea_only_reason: Explosion vs that name's baseline unspecified.
families.mechanism: Sudden huge range then normalizes.

families.title: Relative-strength dislocation
families.idea_only_reason: Needs a preregistered market residual proxy.
families.mechanism: Idiosyncratic extreme vs quiet tape continues or reverts.

families.title: Repeated intraday high/low attacks
families.idea_only_reason: Attempt count and 'same level' tolerance unspecified.
families.mechanism: Multiple touches change breakout vs exhaustion odds.

families.title: Abnormal dollar-volume regime transition
families.idea_only_reason: Quiet-to-hot threshold and post-change window unspecified.
families.mechanism: After liquidity regime changes, subsequent price path is structured.

families.title: Large down-gap capitulation/rebound
families.idea_only_reason: Down-gap and volume thresholds not frozen.
families.mechanism: Huge gap-down + volume may rebound (not assumed symmetric to H001).

families.title: Intraday crash rebound
families.idea_only_reason: Crash window and volume extreme unspecified.
families.mechanism: Very rapid decline + volume then short-horizon bounce.

families.title: Gap aligned with vs against yesterday RTH
families.idea_only_reason: Yesterday RTH return cutoff unspecified.
families.mechanism: Gap-with-trend vs gap-against-trend are different inventories.

families.title: Same-morning gap crowding
families.mechanism: H001 fade when N_gap10 at 09:31 is already >= 80 (crowded auction).
families.rationale: Crowding frozen at 09:31 from 09:30 opens only.

families.title: First RTH after known split
families.idea_only_reason: Control/data-quality family; economic hypothesis not stated as trade direction.
families.mechanism: Mechanical as-printed discontinuity vs economic gap.
limitations: control family, not a trading candidate

families.title: Halt/resume proxy from missing minutes
families.idea_only_reason: Missing minutes are a PROXY not an exchange halt.
families.mechanism: Silent interval then large first print.

families.title: Dormant-tape reactivation
families.idea_only_reason: Sparse-minute threshold unspecified.
families.mechanism: Attention arrives after a dead tape.

families.title: Multi-day runner then first failed RTH
families.idea_only_reason: N-session rule unspecified.
families.mechanism: Swing positioning exhausts on first failed RTH.

families.title: Yesterday last-30m vs overnight gap
families.idea_only_reason: Last-30m cutoff unspecified.
families.mechanism: Close-auction leftover vs new overnight information.

families.title: After-hours → next RTH
families.mechanism: Large D-1 AH move continues into D RTH; entry is D 09:30 open. No D premarket.
families.rationale: PRIMARY is AH continuation; fade is variant H028.v1.

families.title: Morning extreme → late-day unwind
families.idea_only_reason: 10:30 extreme and 15:30–16:00 window need frozen cuts.
families.mechanism: Day-trader flatten / MOC of morning extremes.

families.title: Round-number stall/break
families.idea_only_reason: Levels must be the preregistered set {1,2,5,10,20} only; neighborhood not frozen.
families.mechanism: Clustering at human price levels.
limitations: do not mine arbitrary round numbers

families.title: 10:30 trend-day state → rest of day
families.idea_only_reason: Must use 10:30 price location in 09:30–10:30 range, not the 09:30 print classified after the fact.
families.mechanism: One-way inventory day persists after 10:30.

families.title: Still-unfilled gap at later clock
families.idea_only_reason: Clock (11:00 vs 14:00) and unfilled threshold unspecified.
families.mechanism: Unfilled overnight gap later in the day is leftover support/resistance.

families.title: First extreme of afternoon
families.idea_only_reason: Afternoon clock and first-hit % unspecified.
families.mechanism: Afternoon first extreme is news-like, not the open auction.

families.title: High-turnover low-net-displacement two-sided state
families.idea_only_reason: Must not claim true absorption from OHLCV.
families.mechanism: High volume, little net change, both wicks; then directional resolution.

families.title: Consecutive-close streak
families.idea_only_reason: Needs explicit reset after an event to avoid streak-event inflation.
families.mechanism: N consecutive closes persist or exhaust.

families.title: Impulse-bar close location
families.idea_only_reason: Shock-bar % and close location bins unspecified.
families.mechanism: Close vs high/low of the impulse bar (effort vs result).

families.title: First tag of yesterday high/low
families.mechanism: First RTH tag of yesterday RTH high is leftover resistance (short).
families.rationale: Downside tag is variant H037.v1, not pooled.

families.title: Air pocket in historically illiquid names
families.idea_only_reason: Prior dvol decile and shock size unspecified.
families.mechanism: No two-sided market after a % shock in a historically dead name.

families.title: Tape-wide one-way open → cheap-name overshoot
families.idea_only_reason: Cross-sectional median proxy and residual cut unspecified.
families.mechanism: High-beta overshoot when the tape is already one-way.

families.title: Weekend/Monday gap vs midweek gap
families.mechanism: Monday gap-up of sufficient size fades more than midweek (weekend information/risk).
families.rationale: Calendar/information, not the same as a Tuesday 15% gap.
